items.a: $10.99 flat rate shipping is available to the domestic 48 states. Shipping to Alaska, Hawaii, and overseas is available upon shipping quote request. See our Shipping & Returns page for full details.

All sales are final, and no exchanges or refunds will be issued. If a product is found to be defective or missing parts, an exchange may be requested. Please contact us before ordering if you have any questions.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: We currently accept PayPal and debit/credit card. Checks are not accepted.

items.q: Do you carry kits from smaller companies?
items.a: Yes. These 'Experienced Builder' kits may have fitment issues, varied material quality, or slight color differences, and some box damage may be present. These characteristics do not qualify as defects.
